misconceptions.description: Assuming a resume, LinkedIn profile, and portfolio can describe the same role differently because recruiters see only one
misconceptions.trigger: learner lists a different title or scope for the same role on different platforms
misconceptions.feedback: Recruiters cross-check. Keep the same role, dates, and top accomplishment consistent across all three platforms.

misconceptions.description: Believing screenshots alone are sufficient evidence of a project in a portfolio
misconceptions.trigger: learner's project page has images but no live link or code repository
misconceptions.feedback: Screenshots cannot be inspected. Add a live demo or repository link so a reviewer can verify the work and your role.

misconceptions.description: Keeping an AI headline that claims awards, titles, or status the student has not earned
misconceptions.trigger: learner uses a headline that contradicts what the resume and portfolio can prove
misconceptions.feedback: Your headline must survive a cross-check. Replace inflated claims with a truthful headline that matches your other platforms.

misconceptions.description: Thinking alignment means matching colors or fonts rather than matching the facts of your record
misconceptions.trigger: learner audits design polish but never checks that titles, dates, and accomplishments agree
misconceptions.feedback: Alignment is about consistent facts, not matching color schemes. Check that titles, dates, and key accomplishments agree.
